decision_reason: Round 190 redrew the ordinary obligation map: one-match is off the critical path, the closest closing form is M_w = O(p) per fixed moderate block, and a new obligation (A) assembly is needed to turn fixed blocks into the target. The literature call found MPRRS Theorem 37 (|I|^(32/13)), weakening the Round 189 obstruction, and the structural call isolated (GP-Sub). Round 191 follows the audit's ranking: the assembly (A) first, because without it every fixed-block estimate is insufficient in principle; then two cheap calls in parallel, whether the sector obstruction binds M_w with w kept, and a literature check of (GP-Sub). Cold stays paused. If Round 191 confirms that the ordinary line rests on frontier sum-product inputs plus (A), the coordinator records them as external problems and holds estimate rounds. Weekly quota is near 80%, so Round 191 is the last full batch before slowing to one call per round.
